faq_heading: Royal Heights houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Royal Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Royal Heights, Surrey: 19 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 14 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Royal Heights was little changed, 19 in June and 19 in October (+0.0%), and 9 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.8% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.

blocks.text: Royal Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

19 houses sold in Royal Heights with a median price of $1,125,000 (the middle half sold between $1,057,500 and $1,302,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 21% sold above list. They had a median $476 per square foot, a median year built of 1960 and a median lot of 7,333 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Royal Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 19 houses listed in Royal Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Royal Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Royal Heights had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Royal Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Royal Heights over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Royal Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Royal Heights sell for?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Royal Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,125,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Royal Heights?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (21% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
